import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int LIMIT = 1 << 20;
    static int n, mask_end, final_result;
    static int[] p1_accum = new int[LIMIT];
    static int[] p2_accum = new int[LIMIT];
    static int[][] flag_grid = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] a_grid = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] h_map = new int[10][10][10];

    static int power_mod(int base, int exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (int) ((long) res * base % MOD);
            }
            base = (int) ((long) base * base % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int mod_inverse(int x) {
        return power_mod(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static boolean check_triplet(int x, int y, int z) {
        int[] arr = {x, y, z};
        int[] perm = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (flag_grid[arr[perm[0]]][1] != 0 && flag_grid[arr[perm[1]]][2] != 0 && flag_grid[arr[perm[2]]][3] != 0)
                return true;
        } while (next_permutation(perm));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean next_permutation(int[] array) {
        int i = array.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = array.length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        swap(array, i, j);
        reverse(array, i + 1, array.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] array, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            swap(array, start++, end--);
        }
    }

    static void process_first(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 1) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check_triplet(i, j, k)) {
                            int X = 1;
                            while (X == i || X == j || X == k) X++;
                            int Y = X + 1;
                            while (Y == i || Y == j || Y == k) Y++;
                            int Z = Y + 1;
                            while (Z == i || Z == j || Z == k) Z++;
                            state |= h_map[X][Y][Z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            p1_accum[state] = (p1_accum[state] + P) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        flag_grid[x][y] = 1;
        if (y == 3) {
            process_first((int) ((long) P * a_grid[x][y] % MOD), x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            process_first((int) ((long) P * a_grid[x][y] % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
        flag_grid[x][y] = 0;
        if (y == 3) {
            process_first((int) ((long) P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y]) % MOD), x + 1, 1);
        } else {
            process_first((int) ((long) P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y]) % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process_second(int P, int x, int y) {
        if (x == 7 && y == 4) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                        if (check_triplet(i, j, k))
                            state |= h_map[i][j][k];
                    }
                }
            }
            p2_accum[state] = (p2_accum[state] + P) % MOD;
            final_result = (int) ((MOD + 0L + final_result + (long) p1_accum[mask_end ^ state] * P) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        flag_grid[x][y - 3] = 1;
        if (y == 6) {
            process_second((int) ((long) P * a_grid[x][y] % MOD), x + 1, 4);
        } else {
            process_second((int) ((long) P * a_grid[x][y] % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
        flag_grid[x][y - 3] = 0;
        if (y == 6) {
            process_second((int) ((long) P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y]) % MOD), x + 1, 4);
        } else {
            process_second((int) ((long) P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y]) % MOD), x, y + 1);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                int val = sc.nextInt();
                a_grid[i][j] = (int) ((long) val * mod_inverse(100) % MOD);
            }
        }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            a_grid[i][i] = 1;
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    h_map[i][j][k] = 1 << total++;
                }
            }
        }
        process_first(1, 1, 1);
        mask_end = (1 << 20) - 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= mask_end; j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) != 0) {
                    p1_accum[j] = (p1_accum[j] + p1_accum[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        process_second(1, 1, 4);
        final_result = (MOD + 0 - final_result) % MOD;
        System.out.println(final_result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
